series.concept: Working gas in underground storage, Lower 48
series.source: EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report (WNGSR)
series.series_id: WNGSR working gas, Lower 48 total (regional breakdown: East, Midwest, Mountain, Pacific, South Central [Salt / Nonsalt], Total)
series.holiday_shift: moves to Wednesday or Friday, at 10:30 a.m. or 12:00 p.m. ET; the publisher lists the affected weeks explicitly
series.revision_semantics: revisions published when net reported changes are at least 4 Bcf regionally or for the Lower 48; out-of-cycle special release at 10 Bcf or more. Prior threshold was 7 Bcf before the 2014 change.
series.methodology_breaks_documented: revision policy announced November 2002; modified 2005-04-26; changed 2014-10-07 and implemented November 2015, including the 7 Bcf -> 4 Bcf threshold change. A documented publisher change, therefore a methodology break under the frozen rule.
series.archive: no per-release vintage archive located. EIA maintains a separate historical file of revisions and reclassifications carrying the ORIGINAL estimate prior to each revision plus the published note.
series.first_published_basis: reconstruction would INVERT the current history using the revisions file rather than read a vintage. Route is documented; its completeness is NOT verified. Before November 2015 no such record exists and the position is current/revised history only.
series.latest_known_as_of_reconstructible: PARTIAL — from November 2015, same route and same caveat
series.source_defined_seasonal_reference: YES — 'Historical Comparisons' section with a 'Year ago' column and an 'N-year average (YYYY-YY)' column, by region and total
series.classification_reason: a publisher record of pre-revision originals exists but first-publication reconstruction is NOT established: completeness unverified, and the record starts November 2015. Pre-November-2015 is class C.
series.binding_constraint: if NG is required, the ENERGY family's usable PIT window cannot start before 2015-11

series.revision_semantics: monthly re-estimation by design; only the first release of each month is point-in-time

series.archive_start: December 1973, with documented gaps at February 1974, February 1975, January 1976, February 1977

series.latest_known_as_of_reconstructible: STRUCTURALLY YES — the most recent release as of any date
series.source_defined_seasonal_reference: NO — WASDE publishes no multi-year-average convention for stocks-to-use
series.classification_reason: identity and archive are strong, but historical table stability was NOT verified on the frozen sample (Phase 5 not executed) and the marketing-year start is unverified. Fail-closed.
